title: pvp
summary: Benilla's pvp writer has one verb: CMSG_TOGGLE_PVP with a deliberately empty body (toggle, not set-state), no ack, flag state arriving via the UNIT_FIELD_FLAGS PvP bit. MSUI has no sender for it outside the opcode name and no /pvp surface.

openItems.text: CMSG_TOGGLE_PVP never sent - no way to flip the PvP flag from MSUI
